legal.privacyPolicy:
Responsible party: Adrián Carrasco López. Contact: adriancl2001@gmail.com. Purpose: management of wedding invitations, confirmation of attendance, and communication of events.

Legal basis: consent of the data subject (art. 6.1.a GDPR). Health data (allergies and food intolerances) is processed with explicit consent (art. 9.2.a GDPR) to adapt the celebration menu.

Data collected: Expected guest list: the organizer can add a list of names (expected guests) for attendance control; this data is only visible to the organizer and follows the same retention policy. Demonstrable consent: RSVP consent and cookie preferences are recorded with date and policy version. Access and audit: for security and traceability purposes (legitimate interest), attempts to access the organizer's panel and configuration changes (date, type of action, and technical device data) are recorded. name, dietary preferences (allergies and intolerances), voluntarily uploaded images, bank details if voluntarily provided, date of birth (only to validate age for minor RSVP), technical browser data (user-agent) upon confirming attendance, and, if you participate in the social functions of the invitation (dedications, songs, routes, gift reservations), your name and the message you provide, which are VISIBLE to the rest of the guests.

Recipients: Google LLC (Firebase, Google Cloud Platform) based in the US. Google has subscribed to the Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC) approved by the European Commission (Decision 2021/914) and has a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) compliant with art. 28 GDPR. Furthermore, Google complies with the Data Privacy Framework (DPF) EU-US, UK-US, and Switzerland-US, a certification that guarantees an adequate level of protection for international data transfers.

International transfers: data is stored on Google Cloud servers in the eur3 region (Europe, Frankfurt). When it is necessary to transfer data to the US, the transfer is covered by the SCC and Google's DPF certification.

Retention period: guest data is retained for up to 12 months after the event date. After this period, the guest data is deleted by the service administrator (who has a cleanup function in their panel) and, in any case, is not kept for more than 12 months. You can also request its early deletion. You can request early deletion at any time by writing to adriancl2001@gmail.com. The creator's configuration data is retained for up to 12 months after the event date or while the account is active, whichever comes first; its deletion is executed by the service administrator.

Rights: you can exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, and objection by writing to adriancl2001@gmail.com. Guests can request the deletion of their data by indicating their name and the invitation. We will respond to your request within a maximum period of 30 days.

Right to withdraw consent: you can withdraw your consent at any time. Withdrawal will not affect the lawfulness of processing based on prior consent.

Minors: we do not consciously collect data from minors under 14 years old. If the data subject is under 14 years old (or the equivalent age according to the country of residence: 14 in Spain, 16 in Germany, etc.), the consent of their parents or legal guardians is required.

Automated decisions: no automated decisions are made based on your data.

Consequences of not providing data: if you do not provide your personal data, we will not be able to manage your confirmation of attendance.

DPO: this website does not require a Data Protection Officer according to art. 37 GDPR as the conditions of art. 37.1 are not met. However, you can contact the responsible party at any time.

GDPR Complaints (EU/EEA): you can file a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD) or with the supervisory authority of your EU member country.

UK GDPR: for residents in the United Kingdom, the responsible party commits to complying with the UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018. Google complies with the UK Extension to DPF EU-US, and the SCC have been adopted by the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) as a valid transfer mechanism. You can file a complaint with the ICO (https://ico.org.uk).

LGPD (Brazil): for residents in Brazil, the responsible party commits to complying with the Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD – Lei nº 13.709/2018). Google complies with the requirements for international transfer of LGPD. DPO: same responsible party. Contact: adriancl2001@gmail.com. Rights according to Art. 18 LGPD: confirmation, access, correction, anonymization/blocking/erasure, portability, information on sharing, withdrawal of consent, review of automated decisions, objection.

CCPA/CPRA (California): for residents in California (US), you have the right to:
- Know what categories of personal data we collect and for what purpose.
- Request the deletion of your personal data.
- Opt out of the sale of your personal data (we do not sell personal data).
- Not be discriminated against for exercising your CCPA rights.
To exercise these rights, write to adriancl2001@gmail.com.

PIPEDA (Canada): for residents in Canada, we comply with the Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act. PIPEDA Principles: accountability (Adrián Carrasco López), identification of purposes, consent, limitation of collection, limitation of use/disclosure/retention, accuracy, safeguards, transparency, individual access, possibility of complaint. Mandatory breach notification to the OPC.

POPIA (South Africa): for residents in South Africa, we comply with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). We collect your data with your consent for specific purposes. Conditions for cross-border transfers (Section 72 POPIA): data is transferred to Google LLC (US) which offers an adequate level of protection through SCC and DPF. The responsible party guarantees that the recipient applies processing principles similar to POPIA. You can file a complaint with the Information Regulator (South Africa).

Security breach response plan: in case of personal data breach, Wedingo will notify the competent supervisory authority within a maximum period of 72 hours (GDPR Art. 33). If the breach poses a high risk to the rights and freedoms of the data subjects, they will be notified without undue delay (GDPR Art. 34). Notifications will be made by email to the provided contact address.

Local storage: this site uses local storage. We do not use third-party cookies or trackers without your consent or without your action: the map is only activated upon clicking it. Local storage: this site uses local storage (localStorage and sessionStorage) only for essential functions: keeping your session logged in and caching the invitation configuration. We do not use third-party cookies or trackers. By continuing to browse, you consent to the use of this necessary technical storage.

Technical storage and cache (PWA): Wedingo uses a service worker (/sw.js) that pre-loads application resources (JavaScript, CSS, and fonts) to speed up loading and allow basic offline use. These resources are stored in the device's browser cache and do not contain your personal data. You can clear this cache from your browser settings at any time.

legal.cookiesPolicy:
Gumagamit ng platapormang ito ang mga sumusunod na cookies at storage technology:

• Storage na mahigpit na kinakailangan: ang iyong kagustuhan sa wika at accessibility, at ang session ng configuration/admin (sessionStorage). Kung wala ang iyong pahintulot, walang personal na data ang ise-save sa browser.

• Local storage (localStorage) at IndexedDB: pansamantalang iniimbak ang nilalaman ng imbitasyon (teksto, mga larawan, at AES-GCM encrypted audio) upang mas mabilis itong ma-load at ma-access kahit walang koneksyon. Ginagamit lamang ito kung papayag ka sa storage; kung tatanggi ka, ipapakita ang imbitasyon sa session mode (walang persistence) at buburahin ang mga na-save na data.

• Third-party services (pagkatapos ng iyong pahintulot lamang): Google Analytics at Sentry (statistics at error diagnosis). Ang session replay ng Sentry ay nagre-record ng session lamang kung papayag ka sa analytics at hindi nagre-record ng iyong credentials.

• On-demand actions (walang paunang pahintulot, sa pamamagitan ng iyong pag-click): Google Maps para ipakita ang mapa ng imbitasyon. Kapag ginamit, ipinapadala ang iyong data sa serbisyong iyon ayon sa kanilang sariling patakaran.

• Service worker: nag-cache ng mga static resources na kailangan para gumana ang app nang offline, walang personal na data.
¬Maaari mong i-configure o bawiin ang iyong pahintulot anumang oras mula sa cookie notice. Tagal: ang kinakailangan para sa mga layunin na tinukoy (ang data ng imbitasyon ay buburahin 12 buwan pagkatapos ng kasal o mas maaga kung hihilingin).

compliance.title: Treatment activity log (Art. 30 GDPR)
compliance.updated: Updated: August 2026. This log documents the activities of personal data processing in Wedingo.
compliance.row1Data: Couple's names, date, location, theme, photos, music, menu, sections
compliance.row2Data: Guest name, attendance (yes/no), menu selection, allergies, health data

compliance.internationalText: The data is stored on Google Cloud servers in the eur3 region (Frankfurt, Germany). Google LLC (U.S.) acts as the data processor under DPA pursuant to Art. 28 GDPR. Transfers to the U.S. are covered by:
compliance.dpf: Data Privacy Framework (DPF) EU-U.S., UK-U.S. and Switzerland-U.S.
compliance.measureEncryption: AES-256-GCM encryption of images and sensitive data (PBKDF2)
compliance.measureStorage: Minimum local storage and only with consent

compliance.measureSuperadmin: Superadmin protected by Firebase Authentication + hidden route

envelope-letter-fade.name: Paglaho ng Loob na Liham

decoration-sway.name: Pagkuyom ng mga Sangang Eucalyptus

decoration-float.name: Pagpapalutang ng mga Sangang Dekorasyon
decoration-float.hint: Isang napaka-banayad na patayong paggalaw ng mga dekoratibong sanga habang nasa seksyon ka.

story-transitions.name: Transisyon sa Pagitan ng mga Seksyon

story-reveal.name: 3D na Pagpasok ng Card Pagpasok

story-smooth-scroll.name: Malambot na Pag-scroll
